title: SDVworld-index
summary: A meta-curation tool that builds a broad index of papers, blog posts, and code repositories referencing the Synthetic Data Vault ecosystem, using harvesting scripts (harvest/github_tail.py, harvest/repo_evidence.py) that grep GitHub for SDV-related patterns. The SDV family — sdv, ctgan, rdt, sdmetrics, sdgym, copulas — appears only as regex pattern strings (e.g. 'CTGANSynthesizer', 'GaussianCopulaSynthesizer', 'from sdv.multi_table import') used to detect other repositories' usage, and is never itself imported or executed by this tool.
evidence: harvest/repo_evidence.py:52-65 defines regex PATTERNS mapping SDV class/import names, used only to grep target repos.
needs: This repository is itself the SDV-index curation tool (harvest/build scripts) rather than a downstream SDV user; confirm it is not the first-party project this very index describes.
